text: **dsh-agent-team**（DSH Web 插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 Agent 团队协作。它在 ledger 中保存 Workspace、Project、Main stream、讨论与 Task Thread、Claim 和任务看板；Human 可在 Team mode 界面管理工作，Agent 可使用收件箱、消息、任务、提醒与订阅工具。成员可以分工、交接和跟进任务，并由未参与构建的人验收。适合希望并行推进多条工作线、同时保留人工监督的 DSH 用户。需安装到兼容版本的 Web profile，核心协作不需额外 API Key。

dsh-agent-team adds persistent multi-agent teams to DeepSeek Harness Web. Humans manage Projects and task boards in Team mode; Agents use tools for inbox, messaging, handoffs, reminders, and subscriptions. Install in a compatible DSH Web profile; core collaboration needs no API key.

**dsh-agent-team** 的功能「持久团队项目」：Human 可在 Web Team mode 中组织 Workspace、Project、成员与 owner，并用 Main stream 和讨论 Thread 保存协作上下文。
**dsh-agent-team** 的功能「团队消息与收件箱」：Agent 可查看未读项目和 Thread、读取讨论、关注更新，并在 Main stream 或 Thread 中发消息、回复和交接。
**dsh-agent-team** 的功能「任务看板与认领」：成员可查看进行中的 Task、表达 Claim、推进状态并移交 accountable owner，便于团队分工跟进。
**dsh-agent-team** 的功能「Agent 提醒」：成员可创建一次性、间隔或 cron 提醒；到期提醒进入自己的 Team Inbox，帮助跨会话记住后续工作。
**dsh-agent-team** 的功能「订阅自动化」：Project owner 可建立由定时或 webhook 事件触发的订阅，并查看运行记录、管理状态和处理失败投递。
dsh-agent-team 面向单个 DSH server 和一位 Human；成员由 Team 事件唤醒，团队完全安静时不会自行启动。使用前需运行兼容版本的 DSH Web profile。

text: @contexera/dsh-agent-team README · In the loop, or on the loop：With a coding agent you are *in* the loop: you ask, read, correct, and ask again. That is the right way to drive work you want to hold yourself. It stops scaling once there are several agents. You become their dispatcher, their reviewer, and their memory, and every line of work waits on you.
section: In the loop, or on the loop

text: @contexera/dsh-agent-team README · In the loop, or on the loop：dsh-agent-team puts you *on* the loop. Agents claim Tasks, hand work to each other, and have someone other than the builder verify it. They come back to you for what stays yours: the direction, the trust, and the step that cannot be undone. Both ways of working live side by side in the same DSH.
section: In the loop, or on the loop

text: @contexera/dsh-agent-team README · How we use it：This repository is built by its own team: one Human and a group of Agents, split across Projects for development, bug fixing, UI, review, evaluation, and release. In one bug-fix line, an Agent owner found a defect while checking the live Web UI, scoped it, handed it to another Agent, re-ran every gate itself, and accepted the result. The Human never had to post in that Thread.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Why you can step back：- **Members persist.** Each agent is a named Member with its own memory, notes, and skills. It is the same Member after its session ends, its context is compacted or replaced, or DSH restarts, so you brief it once.
- **Every outcome has one owner.** Projects have named owners, and every Task has one accountable owner, Human or Agent, who drives it to acceptance.
- **Whoever builds does not verify.** An Agent may accept a Task only once it is in review, and only if it never held a Claim on it. Close, reopen, and transfer stay with the accountable owner and with you.
- **The room is built for agents.** Agents pull from their own Inbox instead of being pushed every message, and a reply written against a Thread that has moved on is refused and handed back with what changed, so the agent decides again before it speaks.
- **Everything is on the record.** The Main stream, Threads, and Tasks live on one append-only ledger. The task board and your Inbox are views of it, so you read where the work stands instead of asking.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 1. Check DSH：This release is certified against DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. Install the DSH version explicitly rather than following `latest`: an unpinned install can resolve to a line outside the range this bundle declares. On DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`, stay on `@wowyuarm/dsh-agent-team` `0.1.15`. On DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, stay on `@contexera/dsh-agent-team` `0.2.3`. On DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`, stay on `@wowyuarm/dsh-agent-team` `0.2.0`. On DSH `0.2.1-rc.x`, stay on `@contexera/dsh-agent-team` `0.2.6`.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 1. Check DSH：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 web
```

Install it globally if you want the `dsh` command for the steps below: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1`.

Stop it, then install Agent Team into the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @contexera/dsh-agent-team@0.2.7
```

The version is pinned deliberately: pnpm skips releases published less than 24 hours ago, so an unpinned `@latest` install resolves to the previous release on release day.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 1. Check DSH：This plugin publishes as `@contexera/dsh-agent-team`, with its repository at `Contexera/dsh-agent-team`. The former `@wowyuarm/dsh-agent-team` stays at 0.2.1 and is deprecated in favour of the new name; an existing profile swaps the plugin's name, not its data.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 2. Start the Web UI：```sh
dsh web
```

Do not start DSH from its source checkout (`pnpm dsh web`): source mode loads a second copy of the scope module, so every member reports `selected preset is not team-enabled`. Always start the compiled CLI.

Agent Team is opt-in. Installing it adds the bundle to the `web` profile; it does not modify the Harness installation or shipped defaults.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 3. Verify and try it：Before starting the UI, you can inspect the composed profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output should include Team rows such as `contexera-agent-team-scope` and `contexera-agent-team-client`. In the browser, enter **Team mode** from the DSH navigation. The first useful path is:

```text
Team mode
└── select a Workspace
    ├── Agents   -> Add Agent
    └── Projects -> New Project -> choose its members -> post in its Main stream

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · 3. Verify and try it：When an Agent should drive a Project's work, add it under **Owners** in **Edit Project**.

Create an Agent only in a trusted Workspace. The Team Member preset intentionally grants managed Agent Sessions `danger-full-access`.
@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Not to be confused with：Three other DSH plugins carry similar names and solve a different problem — one of them may fit you better:

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Not to be confused with：| Plugin | What it is | Its unit of work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams`](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams) | Turns the current DSH session into a captain that assembles sub-agents, splits a goal into dependency-aware tasks, and coordinates them through direct messages | one **session** |
| [`toolclub/dsh-agent-team-gui`](https://github.com/toolclub/dsh-agent-team-gui) | A reusable plan → implement → review team with a model chosen per member, and a Run Center for token usage | one **workflow run** |
| [`limuyang2/agent-team`](https://github.com/limuyang2/agent-team) — publishes `@limuyang2/dsh-agent-team` | Builds a team of independent root agents inside one DSH window: mix models and providers, assign one Leader, and let every member work in its own conversation over a shared Workspace | one **assembled team** |
| **`dsh-agent-team`** (this plugin) | Every agent is a durable, named Member with its own memory, notes and skills; Projects have owners, every Task has one accountable owner, and whoever builds a Task never verifies it | a **standing team** you lead from on the loop |

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Not to be confused with：The practical difference: in the other three, a team is assembled around the work at hand (a session, a workflow run, or a Leader-led team) and ends with it. Here the team stays. Its Members keep their memory, its owners keep their Projects, and work moves toward acceptance without waiting on you at every step.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Uninstall：Remove the bundle from the profile; this also removes its composed layers:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @contexera/dsh-agent-team
```

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · What it adds：- A durable single-host Team: Workspaces, Projects with a Main stream and named owners, discussion and Task Threads, Claims, accountable owners, and a task board.
- A Web Client for the Human: create Projects and Agents, set owners, post and reply, follow or step back from Threads, and accept, close, reopen, or transfer Tasks. The Inbox and a cross-Workspace task board show what needs you.
- An isolated `team-member` preset with nine model-facing Team tools: `team_inbox`, `team_thread`, `team_attention`, `team_message`, `team_dm`, `team_task`, `team_view`, `team_subscription`, and `team_reminder`.
- A pull-based collaboration protocol. Agent Inbox admission is durable, but it does not claim that the model has already processed the update.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · What it adds：The Team is one collaboration domain per DSH home. Its append-only operation ledger is the authority; UI, Remote responses, tools, Inbox, and other projections derive from committed operations. Ordinary DSH Sessions keep the profile's normal preset roster and do not receive Team tools or guidance.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Install from a local checkout：For development, install the local bundle into the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-agent-team
dsh web
```

Published packages include built artifacts. A local checkout needs the adjacent Harness repository only for development checks, not for end-user installation.

@contexera/dsh-agent-team README · Acknowledgments：dsh-agent-team borrows a way of thinking from [Raft](https://raft.build/): an agent is a someone, not a something — a named teammate with its own memory and identity, working in a room shared with people. The concrete designs here differ in many places: Projects and their owners, Task Threads and their accountable owners, and the ledger underneath are this project's own.
